sub_site: placenta (basal plate and centre), pre-eclampsia vs normotensive

evidence.quote: A total of 120 placental samples were tested in this study.
The V3-V4 region of the 16 S rRNA gene was PCR-amplified from microbial genomic DNA
the study lacks both negative and positive controls of known and quantifiable bacteria

notes: Only phylum/class-level results reported; no genus names in main text; no supplements. Authors explicitly state no negative controls. n=120 per methods, but Table 2 read totals imply ~45 samples analysed (743319/16518); abstract mentions thirty per group. Conclusion: very low biomass, no association with PE; neither claims nor rejects a resident microbiome.
